annotations.title: Favorite a game or follow a creator

description: Toggle the authenticated user's favorite/follow. Provide gameId to favorite a game, or promoterId or promoterSlug to follow a creator (the same Following list the /promoters Following tab reads). promoterSlug is the last part of a creator's page url (https://www.kineticist.com/promoters/{slug}). Calling twice removes it. Returns { success, favorited }. Acts on the API key owner's own library. Available on every tier, but agents that make many calls per task burn through a free-tier daily quota quickly. Email colin@kineticist.com for a higher ceiling.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

promoterId.description: Kineticist promoter (creator) UUID to follow/unfollow. Provide one of gameId, promoterId or promoterSlug.

promoterSlug.description: Creator slug, the last part of its page url. Used when you have the creator's page but not its UUID.
